objective: For every admissible finite regulator of the frozen v2 revision prove inverse-validity, L1=0, Gibbs detailed balance, symmetry projection commutation and B*B=-L, or give an exact counterexample.
universal_scope: Every finite source-admissible anchored oriented two-cell complex, nonempty fixed-Q tuple state space, all declared integer cutoffs and finite real parameters in the parent domain, including negative m2/lambda_4, epsilon=1, K=2, and zero occupations. No irreducibility, free gauge action, continuum, uniformity, or uniqueness assumption.
carrier_admissibility: The displayed functional must be defined: supplied faces have finite nonempty closed oriented boundary walks and automorphisms preserve the complete attaching/incidence data, up to orientation reversal and cyclic basepoint. This states the domain of the inherited J_p formula, not an extra interaction or replacement carrier. Any claim that the source instead admits a zero-length face denominator must be recorded as an applicability objection.
immutable_rules: No changes to F, mobility, per-root rates, projection, time or ordered limits
No reuse of an old finite PASS as new-model verification
proof_route: Positive finite Gibbs normalization and symmetric mobility
Direct adjoint coefficients plus independent Dirichlet-form formulation

verification_plan.generality: A written all-finite proof carries the universal quantifiers. Bounded executable checks cannot replace it.
verification_plan.primary: Exact rational K=2 displayed functional and exponential-monomial conductance coefficients; exhaustive states/roots on the preregistered finite fixture; compare weighted generator and root Gram coefficient maps.
verification_plan.independent: Separate non-importing implementation using a different state encoding and direct summation/weighted adjoint formulation; verify source applicability independently. Same author must be disclosed; this is implementation independence, not an external human audit.
verification_plan.hostile: Attack factor two, bare root measure, root deduplication, phase erasure, gauge-link sign, orientation reversal, invalid moves, projection normalization and generality overclaim; mutations are controls, never altered production definitions.
verification_plan.Lean: Compile parameterized exact identities with the repository-pinned toolchain. Record which source-to-model obligations are proved in prose rather than encoded in Lean.

primary_fixture_inputs.role: Software verification of an instance of the unchanged model class, not a replacement model or generality proof

acceptance: All five universal statements have an exact source-specific proof, reproduced primary/non-importing independent and hostile checks, a declared Lean bridge, and a final requirement-by-requirement audit. A green finite fixture alone is not acceptance.
failure: Record an exact violation against the frozen revision, or name the one unresolved definition/proof obligation. Do not silently narrow the universal scope or patch source hashes.
next_if_accepted: Record finite model consistency only. Any refinement or finite-to-common-space theorem requires a separately fixed comparison contract; do not reopen original OMC-030 by retrospective import.
non_claims: No T-054 mainline gate, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, causal cone, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
